historical_reconstruction: Source-family evidence distinguishes Maas-Hoffman switch 1 as a nodewise alpha(CML) from osmotic-head switch 2, which modifies matric-flux potential and requires Jong-van-Lier drought; switch 2 is not a separate multiplicative alpha_sol. Source-family census additionally establishes SWINCO-dependent initial versus warm-restart concentration profiles, CMSY inventory derived from water content/CML and optional Freundlich sorption, explicit boundary and drainage fluxes, internal solute substeps, and root salt uptake TSCF*qrot*CML. Exact B1.11 solute-member and restart details remain unverified in this execution. Exact B1.11 source has now been recovered by reconstructing the byte-verified historical SWAP 4.3.1 donor source ZIP; solute.f90 matches the pinned 51,508-byte member hash. Its drainage rule is level-resolved: qdra>0 removes at local CML and qdra<=0 imports at Cdrain. qssdi is absent from this solute balance; no concentration is defined there, so the reconstructed SWAP5 contract must keep it zero-solute or fail-closed. Cdrain is externally prescribed unless aquifer breakthrough swbr=1 owns a dynamic reservoir; bottom cseep can be separately prescribed/time varying. Root salt removal uses tscf*qrot*CML. Dispersion, sorption, decomposition, internal solute substeps, and aquifer breakthrough are present in source but remain outside the currently tested prototype envelope.

source_family_census.initialization: SWINCO != 3 interpolates ZC/CML input to nodes; SWINCO = 3 consumes a warm-start concentration profile and does not reapply the initial table (source-family only).
source_family_census.state: CML is mobile-water concentration; CMSY is dissolved plus adsorbed mass per bulk soil volume; column inventory integrates CMSY over node thickness.
source_family_census.transport: Surface input, inter-node advective/dispersive flux, bottom exchange, lateral drainage, root uptake, optional decomposition; internal solute substeps.
source_family_census.root_salt_uptake: TSCF*qrot*CML is a solute-mass sink; must use the same candidate/accepted qrot as the one root-water sink.
source_family_census.ownership: Dedicated solute-state owner advances candidate salt mass and commits/rolls it back with the physical transaction; Jarvis reads concentration only.
source_family_census.exact_source_limit: All equations and lifecycle details above are source-family corroboration only, not byte-exact B1.11 claims.
